Leading Global Online Broker Interactive Brokers Launches ETH Staking Powered by zerohash

Leading global online broker Interactive Brokers (NASDAQ: IBKR) has launched cryptocurrency staking, with services provided by digital asset infrastructure firm zerohash. Initially, eligible Interactive Brokers LLC clients can stake ETH through the Staking Dashboard in IBKR’s Client Portal, where they can submit staking and unstaking requests and monitor pending activity. September 2026 Exchange Spot Volume Report: total $696.7 billion, MoM increased 36.5%

WuBlockchain data show that spot trading volume across 14 major cryptocurrency exchanges reached USD 696.7 billion in September 2026, up 36.5% from USD 510.4 billion in August. All 14 exchanges recorded month-over-month increases.

Binance ranked first with USD 307.8 billion in trading volume (44.2% market share), followed by OKX at USD 65.8 billion (9.5%) and Coinbase at USD 61.3 billion (8.8%). The top three exchanges accounted for 62.4% of total volume, down from 64.8% in August. — link
